cpos.reason: medl's current official eTanke page publishes an exact Direct Payment price of 0.44 EUR/kWh with no start fee and no blocking fee, but explicitly scopes that price to medl-eTanken equipped with a display (petrol-colored on the official location map). Stations without a display can have different prices. The public official page does not expose a machine-readable EVSE-to-display mapping, so applying 0.44 EUR/kWh to every DE*MDL EVSE would overgeneralize. The exact tariff is therefore recorded as a resolved partial scope, not as an operator-wide fallback.

resolvedPricing.scope: medl-eTanke locations equipped with display only

cpos.unblockRequires: A reproducible official station/EVSE mapping identifying which DE*MDL charge points are display-equipped (the petrol-colored locations on medl's map), or exact QR/direct-payment payloads for individual DE*MDL EVSEs. That would allow the 0.44 EUR/kWh tariff to be attached station-by-station without extrapolation.
